definitions.short: a tamarisk tree ; by extension, a grove of any kind
definitions.full: H815. eshel אֵ֫שֶׁל noun masculine tamarisk-tree (Arabic , Sabean אתֿל SabDenkm 65 compare DHM BS ii. 958 ; on an Aramaic אַתְלָא see Löw No. 38 ; compare Tristr FFP 250 ) planted by Abraham Gen 21:33 (J); in 1Sam 22:6 Saul is dwelling בָּרָמָה תַּחַתהָֿאֵשֶׁל בַּגִּבְעָה ; 31:13 Saul and his sons are buried ׳תַּחַתהָֿא ; it was perhaps a sacred tree, marking shrine.
definitions.rootNote: from a root of uncertain signification;
